request: Pull all Federal Register documents (Rule, Proposed Rule, Notice, Presidential Document) from federalregister.gov for the last 18 months. Treat each document as a regulatory 'case'. Enrich with primary agency name flattened from the agencies list, document type, days_since_publication, plus trend analysis by agency_primary so case-management analysts can see rule-making volume + lag per agency. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 04 - Federal Register Actions' on Tableau Server.

sources.name: Federal Register Documents
sources.description: Federal Register API (v1) - all documents (Rule, Proposed Rule, Notice, Presidential Document) since 2025-01-01. Each document represents one regulatory action, treated as a 'case' in this flow. Public, keyless. Page-based pagination (per_page=200, page=1..50, capped at 10000 results per query window).

args.name: Reg Action Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level temporal features parsed from publication_date (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Pure pass-through of Federal Register documents.
args.stats_description: Long-form rule-making statistics: one row per (dimension, value, year, month) over agency_primary and document type. Includes monthly_count, 30-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to identify agencies with surging or anomalous rule-making volume.

outputs.name: Federal Register Detail
outputs.description: Row-level Federal Register documents (one row per published document since 2025-01-01). Includes document_number, title, type (Rule, Proposed Rule, Notice, Presidential Document), publication_date, agency_primary (first agency in the agencies list), agency_slug, days_since_publication, html_url, pdf_url, abstract, plus calendar features (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Source: federalregister.gov/api. Refresh: weekly.

outputs.name: Federal Register Stats
outputs.description: Long-form Federal Register statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over agency_primary and type). Includes 30-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Source: federalregister.gov/api.
